225136:
## Two Bombs

**Location:** Hidden in the ground; place a Luminous Stone on the pedestal to reveal it.  
**Solution:**
1. Blow up the boxes to the left to reveal a room.
2. Using the pillar, launch yourself in the air and land on the cage.
3. Drop a bomb on top of the cage, then drop down and detonate it. Doing so will open a room on the right side.
4. In the right room, place a bomb next to the switch behind the pillar. Then, climb on the lowered pillar.
5. Blow up the bomb to launch yourself in the air. Land on the cage, drop a bomb, drop down and detonate it. Doing so will open the far room.
6. Throw a Round Bomb in either launcher, then walk back to either pillar near the entrance to the room.
7. Detonate the bomb when as it flies above the cage to trigger the switch and complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Silver Rupee](#loc=246926) - Behind the far column, in the left room.

225160:
## Ancient Trifecta

**Location:** ??  
**Shrine quest:** [The Crowned Beast](#loc=246621)  
**Solution:**
1. Walk right, up the ramp towards the orange crystal. Drop a square bomb.
2. Hit the crystal until the pillar is near Link's platform. Step on the pillar.
3. Magnesis the metal block; doing so will rotate the platform. Drop the block on the lower floor.
4. Shoot the crystal to rotate it once more. Alternatively, Stasis the laser, since it will hit the crystal when it breaks out.
5. Magnesis the metal block on the pressure plate.
6. Step back on the pillar and detonate the bomb. This should rotate the pillar in front of the now open door.
7. Step through the door to complete the trial.

**Treasure:**

225161:
## Trial of Passage

**Location:** ??  
**Shrine quest:** [The Cursed Statue](#loc=246635)  
**Solution:**
1. Move to the center of the wheel, in the way of the giant rotating blades. Move any spiked ball in the way with Magnesis.
2. Get 'scooped' by the blade, climbing on it when it gets horizontal enough.
3. Jump to the central gear, and wait for a blade to come down on the right side.
4. When the blade is horizontal, jump on it and run to the platform with the lamp post.
5. Jump on the gear to the next platform.
6. Wait for the smaller blade, which ends in a staircase, to come to the top. When it does, run on the staircase to complete the trial.

**Treasure:**
1. [Opal](#loc=246637) - On a ledge, halfway up the wheel. Get on the blade and paraglide to the ledge once Link is high enough.
2. [Soldier's Spear](#loc=246636) - On the back of one of the rotating blades. From the Opal above, wait until that blade is down and paraglide to it.

225173:
## Steady Thy Heart

**Location:** In the mountain; access from a hole in the northeastern cliffside.  Blow up the stone mounds to reveal a series of updrafts.
**Solution:**
1. Light the torch on the left side of the door to open it.
2. Make your way across the rotating cylinder and step on the pressure plate.
3. Defeat all four Guardian Scouts.
4. Cryonis a pillar in front of the left-most pillar, then climb on it and step on the pressure plate to open the door.
5. Step on the pressure plate to lift the bars. Then, while hugging the left wall, move towards the boxed until the spiked ball rolls past.
6. Walk right and step on the pressure plate; doing so will lift the bars and release a spiked ball. Magnesis the ball on its way down.
7. Put the ball aside, Stasis it, then run up the ramp to the monk to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Bomb Arrow x10](#loc=247080) - On the right-most pillar, in the guardian room. Cryonis a pillar in front of it to access.
2. [Diamond](#loc=247079) - Behind cracked blocks, atop the ramp with the spiked ball. Once at the top, turn around and blow the blocks, then Magnesis the chest.
3. [Ancient Core](#loc=247078) - In an alcove, in the wall beyond the lava. Grab it using Magnesis.
225174:
## Wind Guide

**Location:** Under a stone slab; Stasis it, then hit it away to reveal the shrine.  
**Solution:**
1. Grab the [Korok Leaf](#loc=247048) from the chest left.
2. Using the Korok Leaf, blow wind on the turbine to open the door.
3. Drop down and defeat the three sword-wielding Guardians, then climb back up.
4. Activate the turbine to spawn a floating platform. To control it, step on it and blow wind in the desired direction. Move to the back ledge. 
5. Follow the path to the Guardian Scout I and defeat it. Then, blow up the cracked block behind.
6. Step on the launch pillar, and activate the turbine to launch Link into the air. Paraglide right to the structure.
7. In the structure, blow up the cracked block to reveal an air draft; ride it to the higher ledge.
8. Activate the turbine to spawn a floating platform. Guide it through the spiked blocks maze to the ledge.
9. Stand on the launch pillar and activate the turbine to launch Link on the higher platform.
10. Activate the turbine in the room to the left to spawn a floating explosive barrel. Guide it to one of the torches around the tall pillar to blow up the stone blocks and reveal an air draft.
11. Paraglide to the pillar, ride the air draft to the top and open the chest for the Small Key.
12. Paraglide to the archway flanked by blue torches.
13. Drop down and unlock the door to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Gold Rupee](#loc=247047) - On a pillar, in the back of the sword-wielding guardians room. After spawning the platform, guide it towards the back.
2. [Forest Dweller's Sword](#loc=247050) - On a high platform, in the launch pillar room. After launching Link, paraglide left to the chest.
3. [Giant Ancient Core](#loc=247049) - On a ledge, high near the second floating platform. Guide it right to the chest.
4. [Thunderspear](#loc=247051) - In the final room before the monk. When you drop down, paraglide to the top left corner on the ledge.

225177:
## The Current Solution

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Magnesis the metal blocks on each side of the black pillars, so they connect through their corners.
2. Magnesis the chained orb near the switch against the left wall to activate the elevator.
3. Defeat the Guardian Scouts guarding the bridge.
4. Magnesis the unchained orb across the bridge and on the pedestal on the left side. Be careful to avoid the switches on the bridge itself.
5. Reconnect the circuit:
    - Step on the pressure plate to send the blocks back;
    - Magnesis the metal block to the right side, in front of the 3rd block;
    - Step off the pressure plate, sending the first 2 blocks back in front;
    - Magnesis the metal block against the 2nd block _while_ stepping on the pressure plate, sending the 1st block back. The 2nd block should split in two;
    - Finally, release the Magnesis and step on the plate. Then, when the hole is aligned, Magnesis the block left;
6. Magnesis the large gear in the now open room to the locked monk room to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Sapphire](#loc=246902) - In the gear room.
2. [Gold Rupee](#loc=246903) - In a secret alcove to the right of the bridge. Near the end, Magnesis the unchained orb on the high ledge to open the metal door leading to the chest.
3. [Ancient Core](#loc=246904) - In the water pool, on the right side. Grab it with Magnesis.

**Location:** In the middle of the pond. To access, jump over the reeds using Cryonis.  
**Solution:**

    - Under the left side of the seesaw, so it stays slanted to the right;

225236:
## Timing Is Critical

**Location:** ??  
**Solution:**
1. Step on the plate to slant the slate until the ball rolls into the goal.
2. Move across the gap using the moving platform.
3. Step on the plate to slant the slates; step off as the ball reaches about 2/3rds of the first slate. Adjust the timing as needed, so the ball ultimately rolls into the goal.
4. Move across the gap using the moving platform.
5. Step on the plate to slant the slate; step off as the ball reaches about 3/4rds of the slate, so it launches into the air and into the goal. Adjust the timing as needed.
6. Climb up the ramp to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Climber's Bandanna](#loc=246609) - On a platform, near the end of the shrine. From the final platform, look down towards the final goal to see a pair of barrels. Magnesis a barrel on the previous plate to slant the slate and grant access to the chest.
225237:
## Toto Sah Apparatus

**Location:** In the cliffside, at water level; blow up the rocky wall to access.  
**Solution:**
1. Interact with the first terminal to rotate the floating pillar into a bridge.
2. Interact with the second terminal to rotate the stairs. From their starting position:
    - Press **down** to rotate them towards link, until the middle staircase is aligned with the others;
    - Press **up** to rotate them back straight.
    - Press **left** to rotate them and connect both platforms.
3. Interact with the third terminal to rotate the structure:
    - First, rotate until you have access to a chest; grab the _Small Key_ from it.
    - Then, rotate it until you connect both platforms.
4. Open the door with the _Small Key_ to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Shield of the Mind's Eye](#loc=246618) - On a side of the first floating pillar; rotate it until it faces up.
225238:
## Halt the Tilt

**Location:** Inside the mountain; blow up the cracked wall to the northwest to access.  
**Solution:**
1. Stasis the seesaw to prevent it from tilting, then climb up.
2. Tilt the seesaw to the right, then Stasis it and climb up the ledge.
3. Grab Treasure Chest #1 (see below).
4. Tilt the seesaw backwards (lower the far side), and Magnesis the chest to keep it in place.
5. Climb the seesaw, then Stasis the last seesaw straight. Cross it to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Traveler's Sword](#loc=246681) - From the ledge past the second seesaw, look back towards the right side of the seesaw. Grab the chest using Magnesis.
2. [Ancient Core](#loc=246682) - On a high ledge, on the far end of the shrine. Tilt the third seesaw forwards (front side lowered) and step on it. Using Magnesis, grab Treasure Chest #1 and place it high above the seesaw. Drop it to launch Link high in the air, then paraglide to the chest.

3. Grab the Small Key from the chest that fell just behind the launcher.
4. Unlock the door at the end of the corridor to complete the shrine.

**Treasure:**
1. [Ice Arrow x5](#loc=246664) - Repeat the above process with the right launcher; the chest will fall from the wall, right of the launcher.

239020:
**Location:** In the ramshackled house.  
**Contents:**  
_Initial:_  On this desolate plateau, the only pleasure that brings me comfort is cooking. And today, I outdid myself! Truly, I created the perfect dish. I call it... spicy meat and seafood fry. This recipe not only restores health, but it also keeps me warm, even when traveling in the snowy mountains. With this dish on my side, I no longer have need of that itchy warm doublet.  
I do not know how I allowed this to happen, but it seems I forgot to write down a very important recipe. I know it contained raw meat and spicy peppers. However... I simply cannot remember what else I used! My age is catching up to me.  
Sadly, on this lonely plateau, I have only my own knowledge and memory to rely on. Still... If I did find someone who knew the missing ingredient, I would happily reward them with my warm doublet. However, it seems unlikely that such a miraculous wish will ever be fulfilled.

_After showing the Old Man some Spicy Meat and Seafood Fry (Raw Meat, Spicy Pepper, Hyrule Bass)_: To my surprise and delight, I did happen upon someone who was able to re-create my spicy meat and seafood fry. I gave him my warm doublet, and I was happy to do so. He is a fine young man with great potential, that one.  
Ah, and I will now write down this perfect recipe so that I will never forget it. Place some raw meat, spicy pepper, and hyrule bass in a pot, and then turn up the heat. Voilà!  
Eating this dish allows you to walk the snowy mountains with ease, though I did forget there's a time limit on the effect. It is too bad I already gave away that warm doublet, which keeps you warm no matter how long you wear it.

_After completing [The Isolated Plateau](#loc=248304):_ Link... Bit by bit, you may come to realize who I am. I am sorry for not revealing my true identity to you sooner. The truth is, after you awoke from your long Slumber of Restoration, I did not know how to tell you all there was to say.  
Perhaps deceiving you was not the right thing to do. Still...you must admit I put on a great performance! But all joking aside...what I ask of you is of the utmost importance, dear hero. I implore you, with all my heart... defeat Calamity Ganon and save my precious daughter, Zelda. I understand this is no simple task I am asking of you, but I know beyond a shadow of a doubt that you can do it. I do not doubt it for a moment. I see courage in your eyes, just as I did 100 years ago. I believe in you, Link.

245067:
**Location:** On a table, inside the stable.  
**Contents:**
From the moment I wake to the moment I sleep, my mind is full of rumors. Even my dreams are gossipy! Traysi here!  
You fine folks keep up with dream rumors too, don't you?  
Well, this one's so good it might as well be a dream. Listen up, history buffs!  
This tidbit is about the brave soldiers who were tragically wiped out during the Great Calamity.  
The royal guards who protected the royal family!  
Amongst Hyrule's soldiers, only the best of the best had the honor of guarding the royal family.  
Apparently, the equipment they wore can still be found somewhere in Hyrule Castle.  
They say a former maid spoke of treasure [near the Dining Hall](#loc=244522), in [the Guards' Chamber](#loc=244521), and on [the second floor](#loc=244520).  
I do hope one day Hyrule Castle is restored to its former glory, complete with royal guards.  
Hmm... I wonder when a royal guard in shining armor will come sweep me off MY feet...  
Traysi's Recommendation: ★★★★★ [5 stars]

- **Silver Rupee:** 2nd terminal room - Ride the water wheel to the top, then paraglide to the ledge where the water comes from.
- **Ancient Core:** 3rd terminal room - As the giant wheel rotates, Stasis the stone slab above the chest. Open it before the Stasis runs out.
- **[Fire Arrow x10](#loc=246021):** 3rd terminal room - One of the blades of the water wheel is covered in Malice; shoot the eye underneath to access the chest on top.
- **Ancient Shaft:** Trunk - From the 3rd terminal room, lower the trunk and paraglide to the end.
- **[Ice Arrow x10](#loc=246022):** Top of Ruta - Ride the trunk to its highest point, and shoot the eye to the right to free the chest to the left.

248303:
**Requirements:** None  
**Steps:**
1. From out of nowhere, you hear a woman's voice speak to you... She instructs you to head to the [marker](#loc=246222) displayed on the Sheikah Slate.

**Next quest:** [The Isolated Plateau](#loc=248304)
248304:
**Requirements:** [Follow the Sheikah Slate](#loc=248303)  
**Steps:**
1. After your descent from the tower, the old man told you that the kingdom of Hyrule was destroyed 100 years ago by Calamity Ganon.  
You heard a voice coming from Hyrule Castle, but you cannot reach it unless you leave the plateau using the paraglider.  
The old man said that he will give you the paraglider in exchange for a treasure that lies within a [hidden location](#loc=225212) somewhere...
2. The Old Man explained that there are a total of four Shrines on the plateau. He said that he will give you the Paraglider once you have acquired the Spirit Orb from all the of the Shrines.  
He told you to survey the plateau from the top of the tower to find the remaining shrines ([Keh Namut Shrine](#loc=225203), [Ja Baij Shrine](#loc=225211), [Owa Daim Shrine](#loc=225214)). He also pointed out that you can use your Sheikah Slate if you need to travel quickly.
3. After you acquired the Spirit Orbs from the shrines, the old man told you that he'll be waiting in [the place centered amid the four shrines](#loc=246220), before mysteriously disappearing...

**Next quest:**
- [Seek Out Impa](#loc=248305)
- [Destroy Ganon](#loc=248307)
248305:
**Requirements:** [The Isolated Plateau](#loc=248304)  
**Steps:**
1. You were tasked with going to Kakariko Village to speak with [Impa](#loc=248306), who will give you more details on your quest.  
Descend from the Great Plateau and head east beyond the Dueling Peaks, then follow the road to the north. The blinking dot on your Sheikah Slate's map will guide the way.

**Next quest:**
- [Locked Mementos](#loc=248308)
- [Free the Divine Beasts](#loc=248311)
248307:
**Requirements:** [The Isolated Plateau](#loc=248304)  
**Steps:**
1. The ghost of King Rhoam told you that Hyrule is on the brink of annihilation.  
Princess Zelda is currently fighting to contain Calamity Ganon inside Hyrule Castle, but her power cannot keep him at bay forever. Eventually, Ganon will regain his full strength and destroy the world.  
Your ultimate task is to aid Princess Zelda in defeating Ganon before that can happen.

**Next quest:** Congratulations, you have completed Breath of the Wild!
248308:
**Requirements:** [Seek Out Impa](#loc=248305)  
**Steps:**
1. According to Impa, the Sheikah Slate that Zelda left to guide you is incomplete.  
The director at the Hateno Ancient Tech Lab in Hateno Village may know a way to restore the Sheikah Slate's missing components.  
Use the map to find the location of the [Hateno Ancient Tech Lab](#loc=247203) and its [director](#loc=247204).
2. The Hateno Ancient Tech Lab's director can't fix the Sheikah Slate until the Guidance Stone is operational again. The only way to power the Guidance Stone is to light the furnace on the outer wall of the tech lab with a blue flame.  
Carry the blue flame from the [ancient furnace](#loc=248309) in Hateno Village to the tech lab, and use it to light the lab's furnace.
3. The blue flame in the furnace is now powering the Hateno Ancient Tech Lab's Guidance Stone.  
Report to the director so that she can repair your Sheikah Slate.
4. Purah has fixed the Sheikah Slate, restoring the last of its basic runes from 100 years ago.  
Snap an image of Purah using the Camera rune!
5. You proved the Camera works again by capturing an image of Purah!  
According to Purah, the album already has pictures from the past in it.  
Where could these have come from? [Impa](#loc=248306) in Kakariko Village may have the answer.

**Next quest:**
- [Find the Fairy Fountain](#loc=248654)
- [Captured Memories](#loc=248310)
248310:
**Requirements:** [Locked Mementos](#loc=248308)  
**Steps:**
1. Princess Zelda left behind an album with twelve pictures in it. Traveling to the places shown in these pictures may help you to regain your memories of the princess.  
_Editor's Note:_ Use the sidebar to find the 12 locations in question. [Zelda's Awakening](#loc=243834) is unavailable until you first capture the other 12 memories.
2. You've found all of the locations in the pictures!  
Go and report the news to [Impa](#loc=248306) in Kakariko Village.
3. The location of the final memory is hanging on the wall of Impa's home.  
What memory of your past with Princess Zelda awaits you there?

**Next quest:** None
248311:
**Requirements:** [Seek Out Impa](#loc=248305)  
**Steps:**
1. There are four Divine Beasts that must be freed. Each race's elder should have more details:
    - _Editor's Note:_ Complete each of the following quests to progress this quest.
    - The [Divine Beast Vah Rudania](#loc=248313), piloted by Daruk of the Gorons
    - The [Divine Beast Vah Medoh](#loc=248323), piloted by Revali of the Rito
    - The [Divine Beast Vah Ruta](#loc=248591), piloted by Mipha of the Zora (requires [Reach Zora's Domain](#loc=248588))
    - The [Divine Beast Vah Naboris](#loc=248651), piloted by Urbosa of the Gerudo (requires [Forbidden City Entry](#loc=248641))
2. You've reclaimed the four Divine Beasts by defeating the four Ganon phantoms haunting them. You should let [Impa](#loc=248306) know of your success.

**Next quest:** [Destroy Ganon](#loc=248307)
248313:
**Requirements:** [Seek Out Impa](#loc=248305)  
**Steps:**
1. Bludo, Boss of Goron City, wants to challenge the marauding Divine Beast Vah Rudania, but his backache is too severe.  
What's worse, Yunobo has yet to return from the [Abandoned North Mine](#loc=246308) with the painkillers he was sent to fetch.
2. You met Drak in the Abandoned North Mine, who told you that Yunobo left for the vault deep in its reaches. That's the last anyone has seen of Yunobo...  
Mount a search operation for Yunobo, who was headed for the [vault](#loc=248315).
3. You met Yunobo in the Abandoned North Mine.  
Yunobo hurried back to Goron City to deliver the painkillers Bludo needs for his backache.  
You should go speak to [Bludo](#loc=248312) to collect your reward.
4. Bludo thanked you for helping Yunobo. After taking the painkillers, Bludo was about to go challenge Divine Beast Vah Rudania, but then his back started hurting again. No one will be challenging the Divine Beast today, it seems.  
[Yunobo](#loc=248318) has already gone ahead to the Bridge of Eldin, so you must meet him there to let him know about this change of plans.
5. You helped Yunobo fend off monsters at the Bridge of Eldin before telling him that Bludo's plan had been called off.  
You still need to get inside the Divine Beast somehow, though... The best way forward may be to [lower the Bridge of Eldin](#loc=248319).
6. Yunobo used Daruk's Protection to act as a cannonball. The Bridge of Eldin has been lowered!  
All you need to do now is to cross the Bridge of Eldin and drive Divine Beast Vah Rudania into the crater.
7. Sentries now patrol Death Mountain to eliminate intruders.  
Avoid their notice as you lead Yunobo to the cannons to drive [Divine Beast Vah Rudania](#loc=246029) into the crater.
8. Defeating Fireblight Ganon freed the spirit of Daruk, Champion of the Goron race. He has piloted the Divine Beast to the summit of Death Mountain in preparation for the assault on Ganon.  
Seeing this, a relieved Yunobo returned to his home in Goron City. You should go there and tell Bludo all that has happened.

**Next quest:** [Free the Divine Beasts](#loc=248311)
248323:
**Requirements:** [Seek Out Impa](#loc=248305)  
**Steps:**
1. Kaneli, elder of Rito Village, wants you to help a local soldier named Teba. You offered your assistance, but first you must find the soldier.  
Teba's wife [Saki](#loc=248321) may know where he is. Ask around Rito Village to gather more information.
2. You found Saki and asked where Teba went. It sounds like he headed for the Flight Range.  
Search the Flight Range for [Teba](#loc=248322).
3. You found Teba at the Flight Range, but he has no intention of returning to the village before Divine Beast Vah Medoh has been appeased.  
He intends to appease the Divine Beast himself. You had better help him out.
4. Teba won't let you anywhere near Divine Beast Vah Medoh unless you can at least hit the targets at the Flight Range.  
If you catch an updraft with your paraglider, it'll carry you high into the sky. Use this technique to destroy five targets with arrows within the time limit to prove yourself to Teba.
5. You proved your mettle by hitting the targets at the Flight Range.  
When it comes time to battle Divine Beast Vah Medoh, Teba will draw the focus of its attacks so you can focus on destroying its cannons.  
Teba will carry you into the sky where Divine Beast Vah Medoh awaits.
6. The battle with Divine Beast Vah Medoh has begun!  
Use the paraglider to launch into the air for a good vantage point, and then take out all the cannons with your bomb arrows.  
But be careful—if you get too close, you'll run into the Divine Beast's barrier!
7. You destroyed all of Divine Beast Vah Medoh's cannons and landed on its back, but Teba suffered injuries and had to retreat.  
You must finish what you both started. Enter [Divine Beast Vah Medoh](#loc=246023) on your own to stop it once and for all!
8. You defeated Windblight Ganon, which had infested the insides of Divine Beast Vah Medoh.  
The Divine Beast has been enshrined at the highest point of Rito Village, and moreover, it looks like Teba was able to safely return to Rito Village. Go report to [Kaneli](#loc=248320).

**Next quest:** [Free the Divine Beasts](#loc=248311)
248587:
**Requirements:** Reach the [Master Sword](#loc=246013) through the Lost Woods, and try to pull it.  
**Steps:**
1. Through the Lost Woods and deep within the Korok Forest sleeps the sword that seals the darkness, a weapon said to be capable of striking down the Calamity.  
Though you came to claim the sword, the Deku Tree told you the blade would test you... Although you wielded it 100 years ago, can you pull the sword out in your current state?
    - Try to pull the sword with at least 13 Heart Containers to complete the quest.

**Next quest:** None
248588:
**Requirements:** [Seek Out Impa](#loc=248305)  
**Steps:**
1. [Sidon](#loc=248589), prince of the Zora, invited you to come to [Zora's Domain](#loc=247376)  
He warned you that owing to the heavy rains, the rocks along the path are dangerously slippery.
2. You arrived at Zora's Domain. The next step is to visit [King Dorephan](#loc=248590) in the throne room on the top floor.

**Next quest:** [Divine Beast Vah Ruta](#loc=248591)
248591:
**Requirements:** [Reach Zora's Domain](#loc=248588)  
**Steps:**
1. You have been asked to help appease Vah Ruta, Divine Beast of Water. The task will require a great many shock arrows.  
Find [Muzu](#loc=248592) in Zora's Domain square to find out where to get them.
2. You asked Muzu where to get the arrows, but he refuses to help because you're a Hylian. However, he seems willing to cooperate if you can somehow prove that you were special to Mipha.
You have the [Zora Armor](#loc=248594) that Mipha made for you. Maybe it will be proof enough.
    - Wear the Zora Armor while talking to him.
3. According to Muzu, you can get shock arrows from Ploymus Mountain.  
Wearing the Zora armor allows you to swim up waterfalls, so swimming up the waterfall east of Zora's Domain will make for a nice shortcut.  
First, you'll need to collect 20 shock arrows.
    - _Editor's Note:_ Defeating the [Lynel](#loc=248593) has a chance to drop Shock Arrows. Otherwise, there are plenty scattered across the mountain; use the 'Arrow Chest' category for the exact locations.
4. You collected the 20 shock arrows you'll need to face the Divine Beast. Now head to East Reservoir Lake and meet with [Sidon](#loc=248595).  
The lake is directly below Shatterback Point, the peak of Ploymus Mountain.
5. You met up with Sidon at East Reservoir Lake and are ready to put those shock arrows to use. Their electricity can activate the devices on [Divine Beast Vah Ruta](#loc=246014)'s back.
6. You activated the devices on 's back, halting its barrage.  
Now's your chance. Head inside and take back the Divine Beast!
7. You defeated Waterblight Ganon, which had taken control of Divine Beast Vah Ruta.  
Divine Beast Vah Ruta has been enshrined to the west of Lanayru Great Spring.  
Return to Zora's Domain and report to King Dorephan.

**Next quest:** [Free the Divine Beasts](#loc=248311)

248651:
**Requirements:** [Forbidden City Entry](#loc=248641)  
**Steps:**
1. The leader of the Gerudo, Lady [Riju](#loc=247297), asked for your help in conquering Divine Beast Vah Naboris. 
Before you can confront the Divine Beast, the Gerudo need help recovering the chief's heriloom, which has been stolen. Captain [Teake](#loc=248652) in the solders' barracks has the latest information on the thieves.
2. After speaking with Captain Teake, you learned that the thieves are hiding out in Karusa Valley, but the hideout itself has not been scouted by any of the soldiers.  
Gather additional information from the soldiers, and then head for the [thieves' hideout](#loc=246588).

Sneak into the hideout, and recover the [Gerudo chief's heirloom](#loc=244844).
4. You retrieved the chief's heirloom from the thieves' leader!  
It's time to head back to Gerudo Town and return the heirloom to Riju!
5. At last you are ready to take on the Divine Beast Vah Naboris. Head for the lookout post where [Riju](#loc=248653) is waiting for you.  
Riju has told you that a fight with the [Divine Beast](#loc=246016) will go much more smoothly for one who knows how to sand-seal surf.
6. You defeated the Thunderblight Ganon lurking deep within the Divine Beast Vah Naboris!  
Urbosa's Divine Beast Vah Naboris has taken up a position in the eastern region of the Gerudo Desert.  
Make your way back to Gerudo Town, and report to the chief of the Gerudo, Riju!

2. Brave several areas full of moving balls of various sizes and spikes. To avoid them, try running along the side and jumping up on a ledge and make your way to the catwalks on either side.
3. At the next area - you must use the provided metal bowl to collect the Shrine Orb as it tumbles out with other balls and objects along the side.
4. With the small orb back in the cup, don't dump it out yet - and head back to the first slope with the moving objects and extend the bowl carefully across to the other side and leave it so you can cross without having to worry about using Magnesis at the same time.

412669:
## EX Champion Mipha's Song DLC Quest
**Location:** Below Ploymus Mountain to the North, up past Mikau and Lulu Lake up the waterfall dams - but you must solve a puzzle to reveal it.

**Solution:**
1. Use Magnesis to lift the left box up into the air, and while it falls, quickly pull out Cryonis and place a block below the falling box to keep it raised, and climb up to the platform.
2. Now that you have a ice block under the metal box on the left, you can either try lifting up the metal block further and use stasis before it falls - or use Magnesis on the small metal block to lift up the left block from underneath, next to the Cryonis block.
3. Now for the other side - get to the top of the left metal box and raise up the the right box as high as you can and use stasis before it drops. 

**Treasure:**
1. Royal Shield
412670:
## EX Champion Daruk's Song DLC Quest.

**Location:** North of Lake Darman in the Northern reaches of Death Mountain - but you must defeat a mighty foe to reveal it.
**Solution:**
1. Defeath the Igneo Talus 
2. Insert a Round Remote Bomb and hit the switch to pan the cannon. As it passes over the target, explode your bomb to send the ball hurtling into the target - knocking it down and revealing a new target further back.
3. Aim the cannon at the chest to break the platform its on and send it crashing down below - and use Magnesis to pull the chest over that holds a Diamond.
4. Shoot the moving targets.

**Treasure:**
1. Diamond
412671:
## EX Champion Daruk's Song DLC Quest

**Location:** Sharo Lun Shrine is located down the slopes East of Death Mountain across the Death Caldera from the volcano - but you must pass a trial to reveal it.
**Solution:**
1. Warp to Divine Beast Vah Rudania and look along the rim to spot a glowing blue portal.
2. Follow the blue portals to open the shrine
3. Hold onto a safe part of the block when passing through the flames to beat this obstacle course.
4. Defeat the Guardian Scouts
5. To grab the perpetually falling chest, use Cryonis to make platforms you can jump to and get to more sturdy ground, then make a new ice platform to catch the chest holding a Great Flameblade.
6. Create new Cryonis platforms out of the waterfall to jump down to, and make stairs out of the ice to get to the Monk.

**Treasure:**
1. Great Flameblade
412672:
## EX Champion Daruk's Song DLC Quest

**Location:** On the South side of the Darb Pond, South of the Bridge of Eldin - but you must pass a trial to reveal it.
**Solution:**
1. Look along the Western banks of the pond to find a giant metal crate, and use Magnesis to carefully guide it to the ring.
2. From up on the clifftop, glide your way down and drop onto the metal box.
3. Avoid the flame jets.
4. Throw a Remote Bomb down and detonate to send the pillar down a notch and the bottom flame down below. 
5. Use the metal block as a shield to strafe the other flames with the block in front of them.
6. Make a passage through the fire with metal blocks.
7. Flip the contraption upside-down until you see two E-shaped sections on each end, and angle them so that they face and block the flame jets on both sides. 

**Treasure:**
1. Stone Smasher
412673:
## EX Champion Revali's Song DLC Quest

**Location:** On the South side of Tanagar Canyon, located to the South of Hebra Tower, and just North of Upland Lindor - but you must complete a trial to reveal it.
**Solution:**
1. Travel to the Hebra Tower and glide down Southwest until you reach this shelf - and look for the campfire of the Rito Guard Mazli. 
2. If you wait at the camp until night, you'll spot the great dragon Dinraal around 1AM as he makes his way by from the East. Hop off and loose an arrow at his glowing horn, and the shrine will be revealed.
3. Stand a few paces back from the final wind gust and toss a bomb onto it and launch it up and detonate it when it's near the stones. 
4. Up on the other side, you'll spot a tube to put a Round Remote Bomb in and it will fly off towards the far wall that you can also detonate - wait for the bomb to start dropping in height before blowing it up.
5. Ride the gusts up to the next level where two spinning gusts are on a middle platform, with two slots for bombs to shoot out. 
6. Use Stasis to freeze the fan that triggers the gate to close - or Stasis the platform as it centers on the wall and wait for the fan to stop spinning.
7. Fly up into the next section, and up across the last few gusts to the Monk.

**Treasure:**
1. Bomb Arrows
412674:
##  EX Champion Revali's Song DLC Quest

**Location:** On the Eastern edges of the Pikida Stonegrove, East of the Hebra Peak and Summit - but you must complete a trial to reveal it.
**Solution:**
1. Head up the mountain from Hebra Tower to find the slope - and a portal in the snow.
2. You'll need to start shield-surfing here and race down this long slope while sliding into all the portals that appear along the way.
3. Help the orb on its journey by moving down the path.

**Treasure:**
1. Falcon Bow
412675:
## EX Champion Revali's Song DLC Quest

**Location:** At the Flight Range North of Dronoc's Path and the Rito Village - but you must complete a trial to reveal it. 
**Solution:**
1. Warp to the Sha Warvo Shrine and head into the Flight Range itself. The targets here have taken on a blue glow - but just hitting one while falling isn't enough.
2. Instead, float around until you have four targets in close range, and while in slow motion - shoot all four targets before you come out of focus, which may require some extra stamina.
3. Use wind gusts to glide and shoot switches.

**Treasure:**
1. Shield of the Mind's Eye

412678:
## EX Champion Urbosa's Song DLC Quest

**Location:** At the end of the Yiga Clan Hideout hidden in the valley of the Gerudo Highlands, near the giant pit - but you must complete a trial to reveal it.

1. Travel to the Gerudo Tower and up and over the ridge to the arena where you fought Master Khoga - and the giant pit you sent him down. Down here, look for the twin adventurers Mina and Mils.

413814:
**Requirements:** Master Trials DLC  
**How to start:** Start by heading over to the Woodland Stable at the southeast corner of the Great Hyrule Forest region near Mirro Shaz Shrine. Inside the stable, there is an open book with the clues.
**Walkthrough:** Enter the Lost Woods through the entrance in the southeast, north of Woodland Tower. Follow the torches as you would normally until you reach the area with the final two torches. Take note of the embers and which way the wind blows them which is the direction you will need to run towards. In order to get the Korok Mask you just need to keep running in the same direction from the two torches, even when the wind changes. This will lead you to a tree where you can use Magnesis to pull out the special chest with the Korok Mask inside.
**Reward:** Korok Mask

**Walkthrough:** Lake Kolomo is found north of the Great Plateau Tower in the Central Hyrule Region.  Nearby are the Kolomo Garrsion Ruins on the southeast edge of Lake Kolomo. 413817:
**Requirements:** Master Trials DLC  

**How to start:** Warp to the Great Plateau Tower and paraglide east to Outpost Ruins. Head for the southern most walls.

**Walkthrough:** This leads Link to Exchange Ruins, southeast of Kaam Ya'tak Shrine and northwest of Lake Kolomo. Once you get there, look for a pile of rubble on the east side of the ruins and use Magnesis to dredge up the treasure chest. Inside you'll find Tingle's Hood.

The second clue leads Link to Castle Town Prison, an island west of Hyrule Castle and north of Moat Bridge. Look around the path with several burned wooden posts and use Magnesis to pull out a treasure chest from the rubble to get the Tingle's Shirt.

The third clue leads Link to Mabe Village Ruins, west of the Ranch Ruins and east of the Central Tower. Once at the ruins, look for the rusted remains of a Guardian and use Magnesis to lift the treasure chest from under it. Inside are the nice and tight Tingle's Tights.

**Reward:** Tingle's Hood, Tingle's Shirt, Tingle's Tights
413818:
**Requirements:** Master Trials DLC  

**How to start:** Warp to the Great Plateau Tower and paraglide east to Outpost Ruins. Head for the southern most walls.

**Walkthrough:** This clue leads Link to Sage Temple Ruins, west of Giant's Forest and east of Satori Mountain in northwest Central Hyrule. Travel to the Central Hyrule Tower and you'll be able to glide northwest, but watch out for Guardians at the foot of the tower.

Once there, head over to the western most building where you'll find a pile of rubble in the shallow water. Beside the sword and shield is a treasure chest stuck in the ground. Use Magnesis to squeeze the chest out, then open it to find the fabled Midna's Helmet. 

**Reward:** Midna's Helmet
413820:
**Requirements:** Master Trials DLC  

**How to start:** Warp to the Great Plateau Tower and paraglide east to Outpost Ruins. Head for the southern most walls.  

**Walkthrough:** This clue leads Link to the Coliseum Ruins, north of the Great Plateau and south of the Mount Daphnes. You'll need to enter and defeat (or avoid) the Lynel inside, then look along the northwest walls of the ground floor and use Magnesis on the buried chest to find the Phantom Helmet.

You'll find the next item in the Sacred Ground Ruins, south of Hyrule Castle Town Ruins and northwest of Mabe Village Ruins. Once at the ruins, check the middle ring of water along the southeast side to use Magnesis to pull the chest out of the rubble. Inside you'll find the Phantom Armor.

The last item is in the Hyrule Garrison Ruins, east of Mount Daphnes and north of Windvane Meadow. Look for a rusted Guardian on the eastern edge of the ruins and use Magnesis on the chest below it to find the Phantom Greaves.

**Reward:** Phantom Helmet, Phantom Armor, Phantom Greaves
